messages:
maria.l: Hey all — opened a docs PR that adds a compact example showing cost vs latency in the Console dashboard, tied to a trace hook. Need UX/SDK review. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4021
jon: Link? I couldn't find it in the PR queue
maria.l: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4021 — includes Node and Python snippets, and a small dashboard YAML. Flagged as WIP: accessibility copy + unit tests missing.
sasha: Nice. Quick ask: can we avoid embedding raw token counts? we should show normalized cost per 1k tokens. Also add caption for colorblind palette :eyeglasses:
kevin: I can take SDK snippet review (Node). Will check batching examples + `trace_key` usage.
amanda: I'll do Python snippet + linkcheck. Small nit: console calls out 'latency breakdown' — can we make that 'p95 latency' for clarity?
doc-bot: CI: docs-lint passed. linkcheck failed: 1 redirect from old /observability/tracehook -> /console/trace-hook. Created issue #789 to update backlinks.
jon: Can someone paste the dashboard YAML here? easier to sanity check inline
maria.l: ```yaml
id: dashboard_cost_latency_tracehook
title: "Model cost vs p95 latency"
panels:
  - metric: cost_per_1k_tokens
    expr: "sum(cost) / (sum(tokens)/1000)"
  - metric: p95_latency_ms
    legend: "p95 latency (ms)"
palette: colorblind-safe-4
```
sasha: LGTM for YAML. Just change palette to 'colorblind-safe-4' (ok) and add alt text in example screenshot caption.
kevin: Node snippet: suggest using `client.tracing.setTraceKey('trace_id')`? I can push a small PR to the branch.
amanda: I pushed a fix for Python snippet (uses `redwood.tracing.hook` -> `redwood.tracing.attach_hook`). Small wording tweak too.
maria.l: Amazing, thanks. Can we get one more headcount for final merge vs release? aiming for docs release next Wednesday. @sasha @jon
sasha: :thumbsup: I'll do final pass tomorrow and flag any copy regressions.
jon: I'll merge after CI green and linkcheck fixed.
